title: First line from a recorded park pose 100 mm from the tower-1 edge, before the heading map is a fact
rationale: The robot parked 100 mm from the left edge at C = 90. Until the heading map and the rotation model are facts the first line is checked with the any-rotation envelope, a capsule of radius R_rot + rho + park_pose_tol = 479 mm from the park pose (safety-model 9.5): it leaves the panel. Turning there from C 90 to C 0 would put the left support at x = -104.7 mm (PHYS-03). The groove itself lies in the any-heading safe zone.
